description: Source code for a JUnit test report generator class implementing the ReporterV2 interface, handling test suite and test case XML report creation, including file I/O and XML serialization.

classes.name: JUnitReporter
classes.description: Implements a test reporter that generates JUnit XML reports, managing test suite and test case data, and outputting XML either to file or stdout.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the reporter with options, setting environment-based flags and output file resolution.

methods.name: printsToStdio
methods.description: Indicates whether the report is printed to stdout (true if no output file is specified).

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Stores the root suite and timestamp at the start of reporting.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Generates the XML report from collected test data and writes it to file or stdout.

methods.name: _buildTestSuite
methods.description: Builds an XML entry for a test suite, aggregating test results.

methods.name: _addTestCase
methods.description: Creates an XML entry for an individual test case, including failure details and attachments.
